LanguageData.DRT.Tut.P1.Title: 1. Darts
LanguageData.DRT.Tut.P1.Body:
You throw three darts a round at a numbered board.
Each wedge scores its number. The thin outer ring doubles it, the thin inner ring triples it. The centre is the bull: 25 for the outer ring, 50 for the dot.
Both sides throw five rounds. Highest total takes the game.
LanguageData.DRT.Tut.P2.Title: 2. Throwing
LanguageData.DRT.Tut.P2.Body:
Click anywhere on the board to place your aim. That is the half of the game the bars cannot help you with - triple 20 pays best and punishes worst, because 1 and 5 live next door.
Then stop two bars in turn: aim, then power. The green band is the sweet spot, and it moves and changes size with every dart. Miss on aim and the dart drifts sideways; miss on power and it lands high or low.
Higher tiers move the bars faster, let the band shrink and wander further, and throw better against you.
LanguageData.DRT.Tut.P3.Title: 3. Scoring
LanguageData.DRT.Tut.P3.Body:
Five rounds, three darts each, straight addition.
There is no checkout arithmetic here - the pub next door plays 501, this board keeps it honest. If the totals are level after five rounds, you keep throwing a round at a time until they are not.
There is no undo. A dart is a dart.
